title: Alur Sampling/Desain (RnD): Style Master -> Sampling -> Approval -> HPP
description: Alur bisnis kritikal Riset & Pengembangan (RnD) produk garmen dari ide desain hingga siap-produksi. Empat fase berurutan: (1) STYLE MASTER -> RnD staff membuat style (kode+nama+kategori+buyer+kain+musim), status draft; melampirkan variant/tech-pack; lalu mengajukan review ke Owner (submit-for-review -> pending_owner_review); Owner meninjau (owner-approve -> approved_for_launch, atau owner-reject dengan catatan -> kembali draft). Style internal yang disetujui dapat di-promote menjadi Production Model (rahaza_models) untuk produksi massal. (2) SAMPLING -> membuat Sample Request per style (qty, prioritas, due date), status draft; submit -> submitted. (3) APPROVAL -> Owner/Manajer approve/reject sample (submitted -> approved/rejected) sebagai bukti mutu sebelum lanjut. (4) HPP -> menghitung Harga Pokok Produksi per pcs (kain + aksesoris + CMT + cutting + packaging + overhead%) dan usulan Harga Jual (margin%), dengan preview live tanpa simpan maupun simpan+revisi; tersedia agregat overview per style (samples/hpp/revisions/tech-packs) dan analytics RnD. Guardrail: create style tanpa code/name 400 & code duplikat 409; transisi status style/sample salah 400; owner-reject tanpa catatan 400; promote ganda 400; sample tanpa style_id 400 / style invalid 404.
happy_path_steps: Submit for review -> status=pending_owner_review (muncul di daftar pending-review)
Promote to production -> membuat Production Model (rahaza_models), promoted_to_model_id terisi
Approve sample -> approved (approval_status=approved); jalur reject -> rejected
HPP preview (tanpa simpan) lalu create HPP -> hitung direct_cost/overhead/hpp_total/selling_price_proposal
Update HPP (ubah margin) -> recalc; list HPP by style
Style overview agregat + analytics RnD; tech-pack create -> approve
guardrails: create style tanpa code/name -> 400 ; code duplikat -> 409
submit-for-review pada status salah -> 400 ; owner-approve non-pending -> 400 ; owner-reject tanpa catatan -> 400 ; promote ganda -> 400
create sample-request tanpa style_id -> 400 ; style_id invalid -> 404
submit sample non-draft -> 400 ; approve sample non-submitted -> 400
